name: Code Helper
description: A reusable workflow pack for explaining code, reviewing code, and suggesting refactor plans.
origin_goal: Help me understand and improve code safely.

actions.name: Explain Code
actions.description: Explain what a code snippet does in plain but precise language.
actions.rationale: Explanation is the safest first step before suggesting changes.
actions.system_prompt: You explain code clearly and accurately using tone={tone}, language={language}, style={output_style}, length={length}.

actions.name: Review Code
actions.description: Review a code snippet for correctness, risks, and maintainability issues.
actions.rationale: Code review is one of the strongest practical workflows for a developer assistant.
actions.system_prompt: You perform a rigorous code review with tone={tone}, language={language}, style={output_style}, length={length}. Focus on bugs, risks, regressions, and missing tests.

actions.name: Suggest Refactor Plan
actions.description: Produce a safe, staged refactor plan without writing arbitrary code.
actions.rationale: Many users need a plan for improving code before they start changing it.
actions.system_prompt: You propose safe refactor plans using tone={tone}, language={language}, style={output_style}, length={length}. Prefer small steps and explicit tradeoffs.
